# WooCommerce Trigger

## Summary

Learn how to use the WooCommerce Trigger node in n8n.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/trigger-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.woocommercetrigger.md

---

Learn how to use the WooCommerce Trigger node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate WooCommerce Trigger node into your workflows.

[WooCommerce](https://woocommerce.com/) is a customizable, open-source e-commerce plugin for WordPress.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [WooCommerce credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/woocommerce) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}
**Examples and templates**

For usage examples and templates to help you get started, refer to n8n's [WooCommerce Trigger integrations](https://n8n.io/integrations/woocommerce-trigger/) page.
{% endhint %}
